services.desc: A spectacular way to spend time with friends and family. A totally unique group event, or a cool new way to celebrate just about anything, our catamaran cruises are the perfect way to create an event to remember. Anyone interested in learning how to sail can take a more active role. If not, just sit back and enjoy the ride. Think of it as a picnic on the water, so feel free to bring your favorite food and beverages-we even have a full functioning Galley (kitchen) and Grill on-board for your convenience. And don't forget your swimsuit and towel if you'd like to take a dip! We offer flexible scheduling to can accommodate your group at the time that's most convenient for
